current.title: Black Swan CEO
current.logline: Riya, framed for a multi-crore scam and left for dead by her fiancé and best friend, returns five years later as the mysterious, ruthless 'Black Swan CEO'. No one recognizes her, but she's here to reclaim her legacy and systematically destroy every life that once destroyed hers.
current.characters:
Riya (now Ms. Avni Sharma): Protagonist, a brilliant architect, betrayed and left for dead, now a powerful, unrecognizably transformed business mogul.
Rahul Raichand: Riya's ex-fiancé, ambitious and greedy, CEO of a struggling real estate company built on Riya's stolen projects.
Tanya Raichand: Riya's ex-best friend, manipulative and vain, now Rahul's wife, complicit in Riya's downfall.
arc: Part 1: Office ke conference room mein Rahul Raichand, apni company bachane ki aakhri koshish kar raha tha. Uski company doob rahi thi. 'Humein Black Swan Holdings ki investment chahiye!' usne kaha. Tabhi darwaza khula aur andar aayi woh aurat. Lambe, kaale baal, designer suit, chehre par ek thandi muskaan. Avni Sharma. Rahul aur Tanya use pehchan nahi paaye. Lekin Avni ki aankhon mein woh sab kuch yaad tha... jo paanch saal pehle hua tha. Usne Rahul ka presentation kaat diya, use sabke saamne anjaan saabit kar diya. Rahul gusse se laal ho gaya. Avni ne ek deal offer ki, jo Rahul ke liye ek aakhri umeed thi, par usmein ek gehra jaal chuppa tha. Avni muskurayi. 'Toh Mr. Raichand, meri conditions aapko manzoor hain... ya aapki company band ho jaaye?' Rahul ki saans atak gayi.

Part 2: Avni Sharma ne deal final ki, aur uski company Raichand Constructions ki majority shares ki maalik ban gayi. Rahul apni hi company mein Avni ka subordinate ban gaya. Avni ne seedhe Rahul ke cabin mein entry maari, uski chair par baith kar ek thandi nazar se use dekha. Rahul use rokne ki koshish karta, 'Ma'am, yeh mera cabin hai!' Avni ne bas uski taraf dekha. 'Ab nahi, Mr. Raichand,' usne kaha. Tanya ne Avni ko impress karne ki koshish ki, lekin Avni ne use nazarandaaz kar diya. Avni ne ek purani project file nikaali, wahi file jo Riya ka sapna tha, aur use Rahul ki taraf badhaya. 'Yeh project ab aapki zimmedari hai, Mr. Raichand.' Rahul ki aankhon mein darr chamak utha. Tabhi Tanya ne himmat karke Avni ka haath pakad liya. 'Ma'am, please, yeh project Rahul ke liye thoda chhota hai...' Avni ne apna haath jhatak diya. Uski aankhon mein aisi aag thi, ki Tanya ka gala sookh gaya. 'Apne pati ko bachana hai, Mrs. Raichand? Tab toh yeh project theek se karwa lijiye,' Avni ne dheere se kaha. 'Warna... aapko bahut kuch khona pad sakta hai.'

Part 3: Avni (Riya) ne Rahul aur Tanya ko apne ghar ek high-profile party par invite kiya. Tanya apni designer saree mein sabse sundar dikhna chahti thi, lekin Avni ne use sabke saamne embarrass kar diya. 'Mrs. Raichand, aapke jewellery ka taste toh bahut purana hai,' Avni ne use sabke saamne neecha dikhaya. Party mein Avni ne kuch baatein leak kar di, jisse Rahul ka ek bahut bada deal haath se nikal gaya. Rahul ne gusse se Tanya ko pakad liya. 'Yeh sab tumhari wajah se hua hai, Tanya! Tumhe toh bas parties aur shopping chahiye!' Tanya ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye. 'Main toh bas...' Avni darwaze par khadi thi, unki ladai sunti hui. Uske honthon par ek beraham muskurahat thi. 'Abhi toh yeh shuruwat hai, Mrs. Raichand,' usne mann hi mann kaha. Tabhi uska phone baja. Screen par ek purana photo chamak raha tha — Riya aur Tanya ki dosti ka. Avni ne phone uthaya. 'Plan B, activate karo.'

Part 4: Avni (Riya) ne Rahul ke office mein jaan-boojh kar ek purana news clipping chhod diya, jisme Riya Raichand scam ki khabar thi. Rahul ne woh clipping dekha aur uska chehra safed pad gaya. Usko paanch saal pehle ka woh din yaad aaya, jab Riya us par cheekh rahi thi, 'Tumne mujhe dhoka diya!' Raaton ko Rahul ko Riya ke chehre wale bure sapne aane lage. Uski aur Tanya ki ladaiyan badh gayi. Avni ne ek naye board member ko introduce kiya – retired police officer Verma, jo Riya ke case mein shaamil tha. Avni ne use internal audits ka head bana diya. Rahul aur Tanya ki saansein atak gayi. Officer Verma ne purane records kholna shuru kiya, khaaskar paanch saal pehle ke. 'Yeh file...' Rahul ki awaaz kaanp rahi thi. Officer ne uski taraf dekha. 'Haan, Mr. Raichand. Yeh wahi file hai... jisme Riya Raichand ke khilaaf saboot the.' Officer ne file kholi. 'Lekin isme toh ek page gayab hai...' Rahul aur Tanya ki saansein atak gayi. Tabhi Avni ka call aaya. 'Officer, mujhe aapki report chahiye. Kal subah table par.'

Part 5: Officer Verma ne board meeting mein apni report pesh ki. Usne Riya ke scam mein kuch bade discrepancies reveal kiye, jo seedhe Rahul aur Tanya ki taraf ishara kar rahe the. Rahul aur Tanya ne safai dene ki koshish ki, lekin Avni ne har jhooth ko kaat diya. 'Mr. Raichand, kya aapne Riya Raichand ke shares illegally transfer kiye the, scam se theek pehle?' Avni ne ek document table par phenk diya. Rahul ne Tanya ki taraf dekha, 'Tumne mujhe bataya kyun nahi!' Tanya ki aankhon mein darr tha. Rahul ko Avni ki aankhon mein wohi ghussa dikha jo Riya ki aankhon mein tha. 'Tum! Tum kaun ho?' Rahul cheekha. 'Tumhari aankhon mein wahi aag hai jo us Riya ki aankhon mein thi!' Avni dheere se muskurayi. Usne apne designer glasses utaare, uski aankhein sholay ki tarah jal rahi thi. 'Main wahi Riya hoon... jise tumne mara hua samajh liya tha.' Rahul ka chehra safed pad gaya, uske pairo tale zameen khisak gayi.

Part 6: Rahul aur Tanya zameen par ghutno ke bal the, unka sab kuch khatam ho chuka tha. 'Tumne socha tha main mar gayi?' Riya ne unki taraf jhuk kar dheere se kaha. 'Lekin main toh zinda thi... bas tumhari maut ka intezaar kar rahi thi.' Rahul ne uski taraf haath badhaya. 'Riya, please... mujhe maaf kar do!' Riya ne uske haath ko jhatak diya. 'Maafi? Yeh shabd tumhari dictionary mein tha hi nahi, Rahul.' Police unhein le jaane aayi. Jab Rahul ko le jaa rahe the, toh usne Riya ki taraf dekha. 'Tum bhi kabhi khush nahi rahogi, Riya!' Riya ne bas ek beraham muskaan di. Woh apne cabin mein wapas aayi. Usne apni chair par baith kar us office ki har cheez ko dekha... jo kabhi uska tha, phir chheen liya gaya, aur ab wapas uska tha. Uski nazar apni table par padi, jahan Riya Raichand ke naam ka pehla architecture award rakha tha... jis par ab Ms. Avni Sharma ka naya naam chamak raha tha.
current.soFar: Paanch saal pehle, Riya Raichand ko uske mangetar Rahul aur best friend Tanya ne ek bade scam mein phansa kar marne ke liye chhod diya tha. Lekin Riya mari nahi, woh laut aayi hai Avni Sharma, Black Swan CEO bankar. Usne Rahul ki doobti company Raichand Constructions ke majority shares acquire kar liye aur use apna subordinate bana liya. Avni ne Rahul ko uska purana dream project de kar uski tension badha di. Tanya ne Rahul ko bachane ki koshish ki, lekin Avni ne use seedhe dhamkaya. Avni ne Rahul aur Tanya ko ek high-profile party par bulaya, jahan Tanya ko sharminda kiya aur Rahul ka ek bada business deal bhi bigaad diya, jisse unke beech ladai shuru ho gayi. Ab, Avni ne Rahul ke office mein Riya Raichand scam ka news clipping chhod diya, jisse Rahul ko purane bure sapne aane lage aur Tanya se uski ladaiyan badh gayi. Avni ne retired police officer Verma ko Internal Audit Head banaya, jinhone Riya ke case ki purani files khol di.
current.cliffhanger: Officer Verma ko Riya Raichand ke scam case ki file mein ek zaroori panna gayab milta hai, theek usi waqt Avni ka call aata hai jo use agle din subah tak report submit karne ka hukum deti hai, jisse Rahul aur Tanya darr se freeze ho jaate hain.
